services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Get ready for an action-packed Ninja Warriors Adventure! Your child will tackle obstacle courses, refine their stealthy techniques, and build strength, agility, and confidence. This year’s camp includes an exciting trip to Funvilla, where kids can challenge themselves on climbing walls, trampolines, and more. A week filled with fun, teamwork, and skill-building to help every camper unlock their inner ninja warrior! And the best part? Each camper will receive a Volpe Martial Arts Summer Camp T-shirt when registered by June 13,
